route_reason: The image is an illustrated realistic scene (brick wall, ground, ladder) that must also carry exact measurements (10 m length and 60° angle), which the layered route handles.

spec.scene: Flat ground in the foreground; a vertical brick wall standing on the ground; a straight ladder leaning against the wall with its base on the ground.
spec.background: Plain sky or light neutral background, no other objects.
spec.ladder_length_label: 10 m, written along the ladder's length
spec.angle_marking: 60° marked at the base of the ladder, between the ground and the ladder
spec.right_angle_at_wall_base: Optional small right-angle marker where the wall meets the ground, drawn as a thin line overlay
spec.style: Clean, simple illustration with exact, legible labels for the 10 m and 60° values.

must_show: A brick wall standing vertically on flat ground, with a ladder leaning against it from the ground up to the wall. The ladder's length is labelled 10 m, and the 60° angle between the ladder and the ground is marked at the foot of the ladder. The point where the ladder touches the wall is visible but its height is not labelled.
must_not_show: the height the ladder reaches up the wall
any value or label for the vertical height
